item.title: Lake Suigetsu: A Scientifically Significant Lake Among the Mikata Five — Guide
item.description: Lake Suigetsu is one of the Mikata Five Lakes in Fukui and holds particular scientific significance internationally, as its lakebed sediment has accumulated in unusually undisturbed annual layers over tens of thousands of years, making it a globally referenced dating standard used by scientists studying ancient climate and archaeology. For visitors, the lake offers a calm, scenic retreat away from any scientific context, with opportunities for boating, fishing and simply relaxing beside the water, surrounded by the gentle hills of the wider Mikata Five Lakes area.
